title: Stage preflight and schema design
goal: Confirm Stage 1 scope, inspect requirements and durable evidence, define schemas and design notes for source manifest, source pack, AID tiering, and Korean-aligned English baseline.

title: Repository source manifest
goal: Inventory selected repository-local sources, approved support evidence, exclusions, and source IDs into deterministic manifests without treating all GPTs/reports files as source by default.

title: AID tier manifest
goal: Classify AID source groups into upload-content, evidence-only, accepted limitation, conflict, recheck, or excluded tiers while preserving AID evidence classifications.

title: Source pack scripts and shards
goal: Implement or update deterministic source-pack scripts, generate source-preserving shards with source boundaries, and create source-to-shard mapping.

title: Source pack validation and notes
goal: Validate exact source extraction, checksums, token/byte estimates, upload-order guidance, and source-pack GPT instruction notes.

title: Korean English pairing inventory
goal: Inventory repository-local paired Korean and English sources, define baseline block schema, and create the Korean-aligned English baseline manifest.

title: Admin operations baseline batch
goal: Generate Korean-aligned English baseline blocks for installation, administration, storage, backup/recovery, operations, and protected-topic product manual sources, or record scoped not-ready gaps.

title: SQL reference baseline batch
goal: Generate Korean-aligned English baseline blocks for SQL, DDL, DCL, DML, data types, properties, dictionary/performance views, errors, and troubleshooting product manual sources, or record scoped not-ready gaps.

title: Client tool integration baseline batch
goal: Generate Korean-aligned English baseline blocks for client interfaces, APIs, tools, utilities, migration, DB Link, connectors, Spatial, NiFi, Tableau, Kubernetes/AKU, and integration sources, or record scoped not-ready gaps.

title: Release patch technical AID baseline batch
goal: Generate or reuse Korean-aligned English baseline blocks for release notes, patch notes, technical documents, third-party guides, and AID upload candidates, or record scoped not-ready gaps.

title: Baseline validation and conflict register
goal: Validate baseline traceability, alignment status, unresolved Korean/English conflicts, AID reuse decisions, and conflict/recheck records.

title: Stage 1 integration cross-check
goal: Check source-pack to baseline coverage, AID tier coverage, downstream routing readiness, and remaining not-ready gaps before final readiness review.

title: Stage 1 readiness review
goal: Run Stage 1 validation, review all source-pack and baseline deliverables, write readiness or not-ready report, and commit final Stage 1 readiness evidence.
